name: formbricks
readme: Formbricks provides a free and open source surveying platform. Gather feedback at every point in the user journey with beautiful in-app, website, link and email surveys. Build on top of Formbricks or leverage prebuilt data analysis capabilities. Formbricks is both a free and open source survey platform - and a privacy-first experience management platform. Use in-app, website, link and email surveys to gather user and customer insights at every point of their journey. Leverage Formbricks Insight Platform or build your own. Life's too short for mediocre UX.
